decks.notes: This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on efficiently removing threats and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also applying pressure with powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance to generate card advantage and close out games quickly. By combining efficient removal spells and powerful threats, this deck aims to control the board and win the game through a combination of direct damage and creature combat.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressively costed Human creatures, using cards like Collected Company to put multiple threats onto the battlefield at once. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant provide disruption and pump up the team, while cards like Reflector Mage provide tempo advantage by bouncing opposing threats. The goal is to establish a fast, wide board presence that can close out the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent through aggressive early game plays and disruption, while also having the ability to close out games quickly with powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also has some control elements with cards like Thoughtseize and Dreadbore to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure smooth gameplay.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures with lifelink and flying abilities to gain life and deal damage quickly. The key cards include Righteous Valkyrie, Youthful Valkyrie, and Resplendent Angel to buff your creatures and maintain board presence. The deck also includes Collected Company to quickly search for more creatures, and The Book of Exalted Deeds to provide a powerful late-game win condition. Overall, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and maintain control of the board with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of spirits while utilizing tempo plays and card advantage. By combining efficient creatures like Ascendant Spirit and Shacklegeist with disruptive spells like Geistlight Snare and Lofty Denial, the deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent. Curious Obsession helps draw cards while Icon of Ancestry pumps up the spirits. Faceless Haven provides an additional threat while snow-covered lands enable its activation. The synergy between spirits and tempo elements creates a fast-paced and aggressive gameplay style.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive game plan by utilizing green devotion cards to quickly ramp into powerful threats such as Karn, the Great Creator, and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck focuses on generating mana from cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Old-Growth Troll, while also providing additional card advantage and ramp with Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful spells to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively with Azorius tempo and Spirit aggro creatures. By utilizing cards like Supreme Phantom and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to establish board presence early on and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game. The inclusion of Curious Obsession allows for card draw to keep up the pressure on the opponent. With the addition of counter spells like Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare, the deck is able to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy revolves around utilizing efficient creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around green mana symbols. By ramping up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the player can quickly cast powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Nissa, Who Shakes the World provides additional threats and versatility. The deck's synergy with devotion to green allows for explosive plays and efficient use of resources to outpace and outmuscle the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to use a combination of Spirit creatures and efficient spells to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggression. By utilizing cards like Ascendant Spirit, Shacklegeist, and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game while continuously pressuring the opponent. Additionally, spells like Geistlight Snare and Lofty Denial provide disruption and protection while Curious Obsession helps draw additional cards. Faceless Haven acts as a versatile threat, while Snow-Covered Island ensures mana consistency for the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck is to quickly deploy evasive Spirit creatures and leverage tempo advantage to pressure the opponent. By using cards like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom to buff your Spirits and protect them, along with disruptive spells like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare, you can control the board and push damage through. Curious Obsession gives card advantage and Slip Out the Back provides an additional way to protect your key creatures. Faceless Haven can serve as a finisher if needed, while Otawara, Soaring City helps fix mana.

The deck focuses on playing cheap and efficient spirits to quickly build a board presence and pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage and tempo plays, while cards like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom pump up the team's power and toughness. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the deck's spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and evasive creature-based strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy using Azorius spirits. By utilizing efficient creatures like Ascendant Spirit and Shacklegeist, along with supporting cards like Spectral Sailor and Lofty Denial, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and quickly build up a formidable board presence. Curious Obsession provides card advantage while Faceless Haven offers a powerful threat. The inclusion of snow-covered islands enables synergy with certain cards in the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

This aggressive red deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with cheap, efficient creatures and burn spells. The goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total by applying constant pressure and finishing them off with direct damage spells. The deck includes powerful cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill, Eidolon of the Great Revel, and Bonecrusher Giant to maintain board control while dealing consistent damage. The deck also includes efficient card draw spells like Light Up the Stage to keep the pressure on and maintain tempo. Overall, this deck aims to win fast and decisively.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to control the board with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, while also countering key spells with Negate and Sinister Sabotage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Torrential Gearhulk and Shark Typhoon to close out the game. By disrupting the opponent's strategy and maintaining card advantage, the deck can outlast its opponents and win through attrition.

The main concept of this Aggro - Humans deck is to flood the board with efficient and aggressive Human creatures such as Adeline, Reflector Mage, and Thalia's Lieutenant. By playing cards like Collected Company, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of strong individual creatures and synergistic effects. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to stabilize against the relentless pressure of the Human aggro strategy.
